question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'of'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a preposition to show the link between *inventions and Western civilisation. * 
 
• Let us look into the usage of the given options as prepositions - 
 
 
• in - We use it to indicate location or position within or inside something: *We went for a swim **in **the lake.*
 
• of - Of commonly introduces prepositional phrases which are complements of nouns, creating the pattern: noun + of + noun. This pattern is very common, especially to indicate different parts, pieces, amounts and groups: *Lima is the capital **of **Peru.*
 
• since - We use since as a preposition with a date, a time or a noun phrase: *It was the band's first live performance **since **May 1990.*
 
• about - The most common meaning of about as a preposition is 'on the subject of' or 'connected with': *Do you know anything **about **cricket?*
 
 
 
• From the above it is clear that of is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

Complete passage__ - *The contract (1) __between__ the author and the reader is a game. And the game is one of the greatest inventions (2) __of__ Western civilisation: the game of telling stories, inventing characters and creating the (3) __imaginary__ paradise of the individual, from whence no one can be expelled (4) __because__, in a novel, no one owns the truth and everyone has the right to be (5) __heard__ and understood.*
